info.location: Holiday Inn Kenilworth-Warwick, 212 Abbey End, Kenilworth CV8 1ED

tour.description:
The English Seniors Championships will take place between Thursday 24th April and Monday 28th April 2025 at the Holiday Inn Kenilworth-Warwick, 212 Abbey End, Kenilworth CV8 1ED

Eligibility
Over 50 – players must be aged 50 or over on 31st December 2025; Over 65 – players must be aged 65 or over on 31st December 2025. Players must be born in England or have lived in England for at least the preceding 12 months. In addition, if they have a FIDE registration, it must be ENG. All players must be ECF Gold members or above.

Rating
Both sections will be FIDE-rated and ECF-rated

Format and playing schedule
There will be two competitions – 50+ and 65+. The congress will have a total of seven rounds over five days at 90 mins with 30 second increment time control, with playing schedule as follows for each of the championships –
Thursday – Round 1 – 16.00 – 20.00 	Sunday – Round 5 – 10.00 – 14.00
Friday – Round 2 – 10.00 – 14.00 	Sunday – Round 6 – 16.00 – 20.00
Friday – Round 3 – 16.00 – 20.00 	Monday – Round 7 – 11.00 – 15.00
Saturday – Round 4 – 14.00 – 18.00 	Prizegiving following Round 7

Time control
All moves in 90 minutes plus 30 second increment per move from move 1

Byes
Players may take half-point byes in any round apart from Round 7, and up to two half-point byes can be requested.

tour.name: LJEM 2025 - Schleswig-Holstein - U18
tour.description:
Bei den Landesjugend-Einzelmeisterschaften Schleswig-Holstein werden die Landesmeister und Landesmeisterinnen der Altersklassen U10 bis U18 ermittelt. Das Turnier findet in Neumünster statt und wird über neun Runden nach Schweizer System gespielt. Die Bedenkzeit beträgt 90 Minuten für die gesamte Partie, zuzüglich 30 Sekunden pro Zug (Fischer-Modus). Nach dem 40. Zug erhalten die Spielerinnen und Spieler zusätzlich 30 Minuten (In der U10(/w)/U12(/w) mit 75min/Gesamt).  Im Rahmen der Meisterschaft werden außerdem die Qualifikationsplätze für die Deutsche Jugend-Einzelmeisterschaft 2025 ausgespielt.

Turnierergebnisse (https://www.sjsh.de/turniere/ljem/)

At the Schleswig-Holstein Youth Chess Championship, the state champions in the age categories U10 to U18 will be determined. The tournament takes place in Neumünster and is played over nine rounds using the Swiss system. The time control is 90 minutes for the entire game, plus 30 seconds increment per move (Fischer mode). After move 40, each player receives an additional 30 minutes (U10(/w)/U12(/w) with 75min/allo). In addition, the tournament serves as the qualifier for the 2025 German Youth Chess Championship.

Results (https://www.sjsh.de/turniere/ljem/)

 *Pafos, Cyprus* |  *April 11–17, 2025*

- **Pafos Chess Club** & **Municipality of Pafos**

  - **Group B**: Open to players **rated <1900**  
    *(Players rated 1800–1900 may choose their group)*

---

**90 minutes** for 40 moves + **15 minutes** for the rest  
**+ 30 seconds increment** per move from move 1
